theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ m : Euclid P → ℤ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, (m e : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.Represents C ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ e ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal |(m e : ℝ)| * volume (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) ⁻¹' A)
